answer: Mechanism: proof-of-physical-founding. Each node buys copper, casts a kernel-shaped ingot stamped with its serial, and records the mass on-chain. A rotating inspector drills a probe channel into every ingot within 72 hours; genuine castings are solid, while a sybil skipping real founding yields a hollow shell the probe exposes, forfeiting its bond. Each puppet separately pays retail copper prices, its own furnace power, and a scarce casting slot, so cost grows linearly with N. Honest operators found one ingot once and reuse it forever.
